reGoggles

Open Smart Goggles For Industrial AI Assistance

Currently in development. Product design and features are subject to change before final release.

Sees What the Workers See, Enables What They Couldn't

Unlike conventional industrial cameras, reGoggles captures, records, and streams the first-person perspective of field technicians, delivering the data to AI models or remote experts for analysis, which enables advance warning, real-time recording, and post-event optimization.

First-Person AI Visual Inspection

  • Automated visual inspection isn't suited for manual assembly lines.

  • Manual inspection varies by person and can miss critical defects.

  • With reGoggles, real-time recording and AI QC trace every defect back to its step.

  • Its HD camera spots subtle defects the naked eye often misses.

  • AI visual inspection complements human QC, removing operator-to-operator variation.

Data-Based Performance Improvement

  • Shift and production schedules rely on line-team experience and habits.

  • Improving steps, processes, and scheduling lacks data-backed evidence, often taking weeks.

  • Full-process first-person recordings via reGoggles let AI quantify operations and suggest improvements.

  • Recommendations grounded in real work, warehouse, and shipment data reflect actual conditions.

  • AI enables rapid team retrospectives, pinpointing anomalies in specific process steps.

On-Site PPE Monitoring

  • PPE and hazard detection are critical in biochemical and construction industries.

  • Manual safety checks cannot provide 24/7 coverage, leaving recurring safety gaps.

  • Replacing traditional goggles, reGoggles provides continuous PPE checks and round-the-clock monitoring.

  • Real-time AI analysis triggers immediate alerts the moment risks appear.

  • First-person incident replay enables safety analysis and liability determination.

Hands-Free Expertise Copilot

  • Machining relies heavily on the experience and skills of senior technicians.

  • Codifying expertise into SOPs to guide frontline workers is labor-intensive and impractical.

  • Experts' first-person operations are auto-captured by reGoggles, building a searchable database.

  • AI distills best practices from massive operation data, codifying them into line SOPs.

  • Hands-free AI guidance accelerates new-hire onboarding, reducing dependence on skilled workers.

Live Streaming Remote Collaboration

  • Precision manufacturing and chemical production lines call for costly on-site expert guidance.

  • Maintenance and adjustment tasks often rule out handheld recording with phones or tablets.

  • First-person footage streams via reGoggles to remote experts, enabling real-time two-way communications.

  • AI automatically summarizes remote collaboration calls into searchable notes.

  • Fully recorded guidance sessions serve as replayable enterprise knowledge.

Real-Time Process Evidence Recording

  • Accurate process evidence underpins compliance audits in petrochemical and other regulated industries.

  • On-site process records often omit details or fall short of audit standards.

  • Workers wearing reGoggles capture process evidence while AI verifies compliance in real time.

  • Every compliance action is auto-linked to workstation, operator and first-person data.

  • With open data pipeline, sensitive data can be stored and processed locally, meeting privacy requirements.

Ego Data for Embodied AI Training

  • First-person operation data from real industrial settings is invaluable for training embodied AI.

  • Conventional ego-capture devices lack protection and hard-hat compatibility, barring many industrial sites.

  • reGoggles fits hard hats and is purpose-built for frontline industrial environments.

  • Hands-free goggles capture data passively while workers do their jobs.

  • The modular design makes it possible to add or switch sensors and define the dataset according to specific needs.

Features

Purpose-built for industrial AI, reGoggles is engineered around safety, data capture, and hands-free use, so enterprises and developers can fold it seamlessly into their industrial intelligence systems.

Goggle-Form Capture and Protection

Designed to replace standard safety goggles — protection and capture in one device.

Modular Expansion

Two open expansion ports for additional cameras, TOF depth sensors, IMUs, or custom modules.

Hands-Free Interaction

3 mics and 2 speakers for voice commands and audio feedback — hands-free, eyes on the job.

Open Firmware and SDK

Built on the open Allwinner V881 platform — free to develop your own custom apps without lock-in.

Synchronized Multimodal Capture

Video, audio, and IMU data streams on one synced timeline.

Universal Connectivity

Standard Wi-Fi and BLE interfaces transmit data to your edge AI, cloud AI, and other applications.

The goggle-form design delivers a secure fit and eye protection in frontline environments.

Your Data. Your AI. Your Rules.

Intelligent systems are too often undermined by service discontinuation and data leaks — reGoggles counters this with open data interfaces and pipelines, empowering enterprises with true AI and data sovereignty.

Private by Design

Capture video, audio, and IMU data that stays inside your own systems — keeping your workplace data secure.

Connect Your Preferred AI

Plug in the AI you trust via open data interfaces — from cloud LLMs to fully air-gapped local stacks.

Set Your Own Rules

Works with any AI agent or app — bring your own frontline AI workflow.

Open Source for Makers and Developers

Support deep application integration and customization, enabling developers to build on their own terms without being locked into a specific ecosystem.
